description.value: Langley Farm Market is a Metro Vancouver grocery chain with seven locations, built around the concept of freshly picked local produce sourced directly from BC farms—including fruit from Okanagan growers and organic vegetables from Metro Vancouver. The Burnaby location on Kingsway offers a full-service market with produce, fresh meat, chilled seafood, deli, in-store bakery, dairy, and specialty grocery. The chain is the 2025 Vancouver Consumer Choice Award winner for Best Fruit & Vegetable Market.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Burnaby location of a multi-location Metro Vancouver grocery chain at 7815 Kingsway, Burnaby. The /burnaby subpage provides the phone number 604.521.2883 and confirms the street address matches OSM. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site; basic groceries are extensively confirmed. The OSM community field ('North Vancouver') is inconsistent with the coordinates and address, which place the store in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the address (7815 Kingsway) and coordinates (49.214, -122.940) place this store in Burnaby — community tag should be corrected.
Minor postal code discrepancy on website: /burnaby page shows V3N 3E3 in one place and V3N 3E4 in another; used V3N 3E4 as it appears in the footer consistently.
OSM had no phone number; phone sourced from website /burnaby subpage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible full-service grocery store confirmed by active website with current specials and job postings. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: seven locations, built around the concept of freshly picked local produce sourced directly from BC farms
